overviewHtml:
Explore the thrill of an Everest Base Camp Helicopter Tour with Breakfast ​​​​​ in 2025. Fly over the world’s tallest Mountain, enjoy Magnificent views, and savor a delicious breakfast at the Everest View Hotel. Nepal Unique Treks provides the latest cost and detailed info for 2025. Most people must endure a two-week trek to reach Everest Base Camp, but with this exclusive early-morning helicopter tour, you can get there and back to Kathmandu in just one day.

Experience the breathtaking foothills of the world’s highest peak and take in panoramic views of the legendary Himalayan range. The Everest Base Camp Helicopter Tour includes a scenic photo stop and a delicious breakfast at one of the world’s highest-altitude hotels. This luxurious Everest tour offers a spectacular aerial journey over the entire Everest region, providing stunning views of some of the highest mountains in the world, including Lhotse and Cho Oyu.

Whether you're celebrating a special occasion or simply seeking an unforgettable adventure, the Everest Helicopter Day Tour is the perfect way to explore the Everest region. The 4- to 5-hour helicopter tour departs from Kathmandu, landing either at Everest View Hotel in Namche or Tengboche, depending on the crowd at Everest Base Camp. From there, the flight continues to Kala Patthar, offering the most incredible panoramic view of Mount Everest and the surrounding Himalayan range.

Best Time for the Everest Base Camp Helicopter Tour with Breakfast

The Everest Base Camp Helicopter Tour with Breakfast can be done year-round, as it only takes a few hours from Kathmandu. However, the high-altitude location (5,364m above sea level) means mountain weather is unpredictable, with limited flying opportunities during the monsoon and winter seasons. Although flights are subject to weather conditions, the best seasons for this tour are Autumn (September to December) and Spring (March to May), when the skies are clear and the mountain views are at their most spectacular.

Travel Insurance for the Everest Base Camp Helicopter Tour with Breakfast

Travel insurance is not mandatory for the Everest Base Camp Helicopter Tour with Breakfast​​​​​​, but we highly recommend purchasing a good insurance policy that covers risks and emergencies. For high-altitude treks like Everest Base Camp, Annapurna Base Camp, and the Annapurna Circuit Trek, travel insurance is essential. When choosing a policy, make sure it includes emergency evacuation, medical expenses, hospitalization, international flight cancellations or delays, and coverage for lost or stolen valuables and baggage.

Private or Shared Flight for Everest Base Camp Helicopter Tour with Breakfast

Each helicopter can accommodate a maximum of five passengers from Kathmandu. If you choose a shared flight, the cost will be more budget-friendly. However, all passengers must follow the schedule, and the captain cannot wait for individual delays or customize the itinerary. For a private flight, the experience is more luxurious and flexible. The flight can be customized based on weather conditions, ensuring a comfortable and exclusive journey.

Inclusions for the Everest Base Camp Helicopter Tour with Breakfast

Private Helicopter Tour: Breakfast and airport tax are included in the package. A minimum 5 people contact Dil Gurnung. There is possibility to minimize cost.
Shared Helicopter Tour: Breakfast and airport tax are not included and must be paid separately.

itinerary.description: Everest Helicopter Day Tours for 2025 5:30–6:30 AM: Hotel pickup and drop-off at Kathmandu International Airport's domestic terminal. Your Everest helicopter Day Tour will begin at the Kathmandu International Airport. We will pick you up from the hotel early in the morning and take you to the domestic terminal of the airport. Preparation and processing for your scheduled helicopter flight to EBC with a takeoff from 6:30 to 7:00 AM. You can check in and handle your bags with the help of your guide. Bring your passport and tickets with you. Your documents and ticket will be checked by an airport official once you check in, at which point you can board your flight to Lukla. (2,845 meters) Fly to Lukla between 7:00 and 8:00 AM You will take off for Lukla after completing your airport formalities. Fantastic views of lush hills will greet you as you take to the air. After passing past Dolakha village, you will arrive at Jiri village. A lush rhododendron forest covers the Lamjura-La Pass (3,550 m), which is covered on the helicopter journey. You will arrive at Lukla with stunning views of the Himalayan chains in about 45 minutes. At 2,820 meters above sea level, Lukla is located. The Lukla Airport, which has the shortest runway in the world, is what makes Lukla notable. As you arrive in Lukla, you will begin to experience the local Sherpa culture and way of life. You are at the airport Fly to Kala Patthar between 8:15 and 8:30 AM (5,450 meters) You will take off for Kala Patthar after refueling at the Lukla airport. Whether it's the fabled Everest Base Camp or the massive Khumbu glacier, the in-flight commentary will pinpoint your exact location. By flying over Kala Patthar in the second half of the journey, you will have fantastic views of mountains like Everest, Pumori, and the Lhotse summit. Land and explore the area around Kala Patthar from 8:30 to 8:45 A.M. (5,450 meters) This helicopter trip is more than just a flight during which you may admire the stunning scenery below. The 3- to 4-hour Everest Helicopter tour allows you to land in Kalapatthar, where you may admire the magnificent, majestic peaks of Everest. Fly to Syangboche (Everest View Hotel) between 8:45 and 9:00 AM (3,950 meters) You will have a guide with you the entire time as you soar through the mountains, who will provide you with all the information you require for the sights you can see while the brilliant hues of a paradise morning meld together. You'll be itching for another helicopter trip after this little flight. Following your time at Kala Patthar, you will fly to the Everest View Hotel, the world's highest hotel, for a sumptuous breakfast. The Khumbu Glacier, Gorak Shep, monasteries, Chortens, and snow-capped Everest region peaks are all magnificently visible from the air. Breakfast is served from 9:00 to 9:30 AM at the Everest View Hotel. Everest View Hotel is a well-known landmark in Syangboche. 9:30 Fly to Lukla between and 10:00 AM and refuel You will fly back to Lukla with breathtaking views of the Himalayas after a fantastic breakfast in the hotel. Nothing is more thrilling than a clear, up-close glimpse of the Himalayas from a bird's eye perspective. Once more, the plane will make a 15-minute fuel stop at Lukla before returning to Kathmandu. 10:00 -: 11:00 AM Return to Kathmandu by air. Eventually, when you look down over Namche Bazaar, Lukla, and Phakding before returning to Kathmandu, you will observe the complete range of the Everest region's landscape diversity. You will be driven back to your accommodation in a comfortable, private vehicle after this thrilling flight.
